question: Can exterior multiface quadratures recover the cycle–face sector and discriminate filled and hollow AW5?

objects.definition: Face circulation and weighted coexact face coordinate
objects.normalization: G=K inverse square root on positive spectral subspace applied to H

assumptions.definition: Unit metric and unforced real skew evolution of oriented simplicial chains

technique_plan.technique: Signed incidence, exact rank, characteristic polynomial and output intertwining
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: Prove autonomous readout and exact indistinguishability

dynamics_readout.state_space: Full signed chain carriers of dimensions 46 and 47
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: Matched projected initial conditions for trace identity

known_targets: Prior AW5 harmonic and single-face results

calculation_steps: Verify the raw face-output intertwining identity
Compare ranks, characteristic polynomial and exterior rows

result.exact_expression: Exact real multiface readout has exterior rank 22 on both carriers. Matched projected preparations have identical traces because B2 coincides.
result.scope: Oriented unit-weight AW5 with matched projected states

counterexamples_and_failures: The common cycle–face readout cannot distinguish matched hollow and filled preparations.
limitations: Face harmonic and top-cell sectors are outside the projection.
next_discriminant: Build a complementary face readout sensitive to ker B2 and use it to discriminate the carriers.
